Offering a perfect balance of umami, sweetness, and medium-hot spice, this ramen will transport you to the vibrant streets of Seoul with every satisfying slurp. The chunky chicken pieces add a delightful texture, making this a truly fulfilling and hearty meal. Ready in just 5 minutes, Knorr Gochujang Chicken Noodles is the ideal quick and flavourful option for busy days or a comforting snack. Whether you're a fan of Korean cuisine or simply craving a spicy ramen experience, this dish is a must-try that will take your noodle game to new heights.

details.description: Experience the vibrant and authentic flavours of Korea with Knorr's Korean Gochujang Sauce. With this sauce, you can effortlessly elevate your stir-fries, enhance your soups and stews, and even create exciting fusion cuisine. The possibilities are endless with Knorr's Gochujang Sauce. Knorr offers four exciting Chinese ready-to-cook variants:
Chinese Manchurian, Chilli, Schezuan gravy mixes, and Fried Rice/Noodles
instant mix. Great taste is in our nature. Now make restaurant-like Chinese at
home with Knorr Chinese Easy to Cook in just three steps.
Make in 3 Easy Steps:
Prepare Manchurian balls by mixing 2 cups of grated
vegetables with 1/2 cup maida and water to make a pakora-style batter. Shape
into balls and deep fry until golden.
Stir-fry 2 cups of chopped vegetables until cooked.
In a separate bowl, mix the contents of this pack with
450 ml water. Add to the vegetables and cook until the sauce thickens. Add the
Manchurian balls, cook for 1 minute, and serve hot.

details.description: New Knorr Chicken Cubes is a unique product that’s made with the best quality chicken and a special blend of spices including onion, garlic, celery, turmeric, white pepper and others to give you the flavour of slow-cooked chicken instantly. Knorr Chicken Cube helps you make restaurants like chicken curry from the comfort of your home. Just 2 minutes before switching off the flame, add One Knorr Chicken Cube to 750g of any dish, mix it well and cover with lid. You can either pick, press & drop the cube or you can crumble the cube in your hands & sprinkle it over your dish. If you enjoy non-vegetarian dishes, Knorr Chicken cube will instantly add a non-veg flavour to your regular veg dish making it delicious to eat. So not just Chicken curry, you can add it to your veg pulao, veg stew, dhal, ghee rice, etc. There are no added artificial colour or flavours and there are no added preservatives. The product contains salt so there is no need to add salt to the dish. Each pack of Knorr Chicken Cubes has 6 cubes, each separately wrapped in foil for convenient usage as required. The cubes can be used within 12 months from the date of manufacturing.
details.ingredients: Chicken Powder, Spices, Condiments
details.usageInstructions:
1) Add 1 cube directly into 750 g cooked dish and mix it well.
2) Cover and cook for 2 minutes on low flame.
3) Serve hot.
